messages:
anya: CI alert - master: integration/model-inference job is red on macos-2. Started after PR #7894 merged (~08:12 UTC). Failing test: mock_server_test.TestResponseTimeout. Can someone bisect/confirm last green?

ci-bot: [CI] Build failed: https://ci.redwood.example/teams/infra/builds/12345 -> job: macos-2/integration/model-inference

sahil: that's my PR, I changed mock server delay handling. I didn't touch macos-specific infra though. I can look now.

liz: can you paste the failing log snippet? I can try to repro on local mac VM.

anya: logs: 
```
FAIL: mock_server_test.go:78: Expected response in 200ms, got 1200ms
--- FAIL: TestResponseTimeout (0.00s)
    mock_server_test.go:78: timeout waiting for response
runtime: goroutine stack:\n...
```
Also when I set MOCK_DELAY=enabled in docker the linux job also times out intermittently.

tom: last-green commit for that job is aaabbbccc (merge-base before #7894). @ci-bot can we run git-bisect between aaabbbccc and HEAD for that integration suite?

ci-bot: Triggered bisect job: https://ci.redwood.example/teams/infra/bisect/6789. Will run binary-elim across commits and post back. ETA ~30m.

sahil: if bisect points at my change I'll revert immediately. Meanwhile can we relax the mock timeout in CI (`MOCK_TIMEOUT=5000`) as a hotfix?

miguel: +1 to revert-first if bisect confirms. Note: macos-2 worker 3 showed memory pressure earlier today, might amplify timeouts.

anya: good plan. tagging @eng-oncall if we need worker investigation. please react :eyes: if you care. I'll monitor bisect updates.

ci-bot: Bisect complete. Culprit commit: 9f8e7d2 by @sahil — introduced nondeterministic timer in mock server. Result details: https://ci.redwood.example/teams/infra/bisect/6789/result

sahil: confirmed, rolling back in PR #7908 now. Sorry for the hit, will add deterministic timers and tests.

ci-bot: PR #7908 CI: macos-2/integration/model-inference — BUILD PASSED. Marking incident resolved.

anya: thanks all. follow-up: sahil please add a small e2e that runs mocks under `MOCK_DELAY` variations and a CI gating test.
